excerpt: Work begins today at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Brookhaven National Laboratory to remove components from the Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider (RHIC) ... the first step in transforming the renowned collider into ... the world's only fully polarized Electron-Ion Collider (EIC). One of RHIC's ion storage rings, the pre-accelerator chain, and a large detector hall will be reused for the new facility.
title: Transformation of RHIC to EIC Begins
